preconditions.description: The number of balls in Jacob's tree is between 2 and 200,000.
The number of balls the teacher will inspect is between 1 and the total number of balls in the tree.
The time Jacob used to build each ball is between 1 and 1,000,000.
Each connection between balls is between 1 and the total number of balls in the tree.
Each connection is between two different balls.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the maximum grade Jacob can get.
